title: Philadelphia Experiment sailors stuck in walls

tellings.quote: And that's temporal displacement. The rumors that the people were some people were stuck between a wall or like physical physical matter and space.

plain: In the Philadelphia Experiment, a rumoured 1943 US Navy test in Philadelphia, some sailors are said to have ended up stuck inside walls or other solid matter. A guest named Dave Rossi, who says aliens taught him advanced physics, repeats these rumours to Michels and calls what happened 'temporal displacement', meaning the men were shifted out of their normal place in space and time.
